title: Step Therapy Protocol Schedule by Northbridge Clinical Package
content:
This schedule of the Utilization Management Program lists, for each review package, the step therapy targets, the prerequisite drugs that must have been tried first, how many different prerequisites must have been tried, and the claims-history terms used to test a trial.

## Protocols

| Target drug | Prerequisite drug(s) | Different prerequisites required | Packages where the protocol applies |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mounjaro | metformin | 1 | Standard, Advanced, Advanced Plus, Comprehensive, Comprehensive Specialty |
| Ozempic | metformin | 1 | Advanced, Advanced Plus, Comprehensive, Comprehensive Specialty |
| Nurtec ODT | sumatriptan | 1 | Advanced, Advanced Plus, Comprehensive, Comprehensive Specialty |
| Ubrelvy | sumatriptan | 1 | Advanced, Advanced Plus, Comprehensive, Comprehensive Specialty |
| Xarelto | Eliquis | 1 | Advanced, Advanced Plus, Comprehensive, Comprehensive Specialty |
| Skyrizi | adalimumab-adaz | 1 | Advanced Plus, Comprehensive, Comprehensive Specialty |
| Rinvoq | adalimumab-adaz | 1 | Advanced Plus, Comprehensive |
| Rinvoq | adalimumab-adaz and Skyrizi | 2 | Comprehensive Specialty |
| Breztri Aerosphere | Trelegy Ellipta | 1 | Advanced Plus, Comprehensive, Comprehensive Specialty |
| Lantus | insulin glargine-yfgn | 1 | Comprehensive, Comprehensive Specialty |
| Enbrel | adalimumab-adaz | 1 | Comprehensive, Comprehensive Specialty |
| Humira | adalimumab-adaz | 1 | Comprehensive Specialty |

Package names are shortened in the last column; each is a Northbridge Clinical package. Northbridge Clinical Essentials has no step therapy protocol.

## Claims-history terms

| Review package | Look-back (calendar days before the evaluation date, that date as day zero) | Minimum cumulative days supply that counts as a trial | Step edit checked automatically at billing | Grandfathering look-back (calendar days before the claim date, that date as day zero) | Automated step approval recorded as an auto-approved case event |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Clinical Essentials | 0 (no step program) | 0 (no step program) | No | 0 (no grandfathering) | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Standard | 120 | 30 | Yes | 90 | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced | 180 | 30 | Yes | 120 | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Advanced Plus | 180 | 28 | Yes | 120 | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive | 365 | 28 | Yes | 180 | Yes |
| Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive Specialty | 365 | 28 | Yes | 180 | Yes |

### Notes to the schedule

- Rinvoq is the one target whose protocol differs between packages: on Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive Specialty both adalimumab-adaz and Skyrizi must have been tried (2 different prerequisites); on Advanced Plus and Comprehensive a trial of adalimumab-adaz alone suffices.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* on Northbridge Clinical Advanced Plus a metformin history totalling 28 days supply inside the 180-day look-back counts as a trial; 27 days supply does not. On Northbridge Clinical Standard the same 28 days would fall short of the 30-day minimum.
